note: Adapted from Bose 1999; the original gives only measurements, synonymy and distribution, with no morphological description. The original records the synonym Indotermes bangladeshiensis Akhtar, 1975, and notes that the original description of 1962 was Speculitermes cyclops rongrensis Roonwal & Chhotani, transferred to Indotermes in 1986. Measurements in millimetres.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The original follows the classification of Roonwal & Chhotani and records the synonym Indotermes bangladeshiensis Akhtar, 1975; the original description of 1962 was Speculitermes cyclops rongrensis, moved to Indotermes in 1986. Distribution: northeastern India (Assam, Sonai Rupai forest; Meghalaya, Barapani/Shillong/Mawroh/Umsing/Mowing; Mizoram, Aizwal; Arunachal Pradesh, Itanagar Ganga Lake and the Kimin—Ziro road), and outside India Bhutan, Bangladesh and Thailand.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Measurements of 2 soldiers by Bose 1999 (mm): total body length about 7.0—7.5; head length (to the mandibular base) 2.30—2.32; maximum head width 2.00—2.07; left mandible length 1.33—1.35, the distance from the tooth to the apex 0.58—0.60; right mandible length 1.34—1.38, the distance from the tooth to the apex 0.58—0.62; labrum length 0.35—0.40, width 0.40—0.43; pronotum length 0.70—0.75, width 0.97—1.03; mesonotum width 0.73—0.80; metanotum width 0.90—1.00; antennae 14-segmented (segment 3 longer than segment 2). The original gives no description of the body colour, head shape, mandibular dentition or pilosity.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements of the queen (1 specimen) (mm): total body length (with the inflated abdomen) about 19.20; head length (to the apex of the labrum) 2.05; head length (to the mandibular base) 1.25; head length (to the postclypeus) 1.22; maximum head width 1.67; postclypeus length 0.30, width 0.73; median dorsal spot length 0.18, width 0.175; long diameter of the compound eye 0.40; ocellus length 0.20, width 0.12; distance between the compound eye and the ocellus 0.10; distance between the ocellus and the antenna 0.20; antennae 12-segmented (segment 3 and segment 2 subequal).
